quotes.quote: Renamed LIFECYCLE_PHASE_SUCCEEDED to LIFECYCLE_PHASE_COMPLETED and updated all usages, since test_lbl_002 expected the trustyai.opendatahub.io/evaluation-phase Job label to be "Succeeded" on success but EvalHub sets it to "Completed" (confirmed live via oc get jobs --show-labels: Pending -> Running -> Completed).
cross checked with evalhub go source
Updated lifecycle status handling to use **“Completed”** for finished evaluations.
